tidewater.name: Tidewater Naval Shipbuilding
tidewater.desc: Atlantic seaboard yards building big, fast, heavily gunned ships in long series.

clydemouth.name: Clydemouth & Tyne
clydemouth.desc: Old northern yards: well-armoured, seaworthy ships with conservative engineering.

ostsee.name: Ostsee-Werke
ostsee.desc: Baltic yards known for broad, stable hulls, high-pressure machinery and twin turrets.

neva.name: Neva Admiralty Yards
neva.desc: Directorate state yards that took over the Ostsee drawings after the armistice and built on them.

seto.name: Seto Naval Arsenal
seto.desc: Pacific yards favouring speed, very heavy guns and long-range torpedoes on light hulls.

tirreno.name: Cantieri del Tirreno
tirreno.desc: Mediterranean yards building elegant, very fast ships that trade armour for speed.

marine.name: Combine Marine
marine.desc: The Meridian Combine's merchant yards: freighters and cheap, robust escorts.

concord.name: Atlantic Concord
concord.desc: Legacy maritime empire: the Anglo-American naval compact that never stood down after the armistice.

directorate.name: Eurasian Directorate
directorate.desc: Continental successor state still fighting the unfinished war from the Baltic, the Arctic and the Black Sea.

pacific.name: Pacific Federation
pacific.desc: Rising industrial power with a vast merchant marine and an ambitious young navy.

combine.name: Meridian Combine
combine.desc: Corporate trading consortium whose private fleets guard the Indian Ocean arteries.

republic.name: Iberian Free Republic
republic.desc: Revolutionary breakaway regime holding the Atlantic gate to the Mediterranean.

freeport.name: Freeport Syndicate
freeport.desc: Alliance of smuggling dens and free harbours. No questions asked, and nothing comes cheap.

enclave.name: Halvard Enclaves
enclave.desc: Neutral scientific enclaves at the ends of the earth, holding technology no navy can buy outright.

raiders.name: Black Flag raiders
raiders.desc: Pirates and deserters preying on everyone.
